Post 1

📉 8 points. That's all that separated the ASX 200 from flat on Thursday — closing at 8,719.70. But beneath the calm surface, Materials cratered 3.95% and IT fell 3.41%. The index held. The internals didn't. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

🔻 Materials off 3.95%, IT down 3.41% — the session's clear losers. Consumer Staples surged 3.47% and Financials added 2.19% to absorb the blow. Classic defensive rotation: growth sold, stability bought. #ASX #ausbiz #banking

Post 3

🟢 GDG up 17.16% to AUD 3.14 — the session's standout. Generation Development Group led the entire ASX 200, nearly doubling the next best gain. When a stock moves that far on a flat-index day, something specific happened. Watch for the catalyst. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 5,987.82/oz with AUD/USD at 0.6945. Silver AUD 81.03/oz. Platinum AUD 2,316.66/oz. Precious metals holding firm even as Materials stocks sold off hard — a divergence worth tracking. #gold #silver #metals #ASX

Post 5

Materials down 3.95% in a single session with Champion Iron off 9.67% and Sunrise Energy Metals -10.41%. The key question: does gold at AUD 5,987.82/oz hold USD 4,000 equivalent? Where do you see Materials heading into next week? #ASX #mining #ironore #ausbiz
